parts.text: Research Position in Human-Computer Interaction (full-time, E 13 TV-L) Reference No: 2026/008. The start date is 01.04.2026, or later by agreement. The position is available till 30th June 2027, and is paid according to the collective agreement TV-L <

> 13.

Join the Human Computer Interaction (HCI) group <

) at the University of Konstanz for an opportunity to research future interaction paradigms for Mixed Reality in Visual Computing.

The research position is funded by the Collaborative Research Center Quantitative Methods for Visual Computing SFB-TRR 161 <
). You will be part of the project C01: Evaluating Mixed Reality Experiences <

). We work toward improving interaction with immersive technologies through novel user interfaces and interaction techniques by studying human perceptual processing, behavior, and experience.

Questions can be directed to Prof. Harald Reiterer <

>.
